book.name: Matayu
book.title: Nhalo ghwa maha handa paghutyekitwe na Matayu

content: Yesu kangunlamiha mundu yunamaloha
Yesu pakahulukite kukitumbi, lumati lukulu lwa bhandu lukintughila.
Mundu yumu yunamaloha kakihika na kakinchutamila mayughwa paking'ombela, “Bambo, handa ghungupala, ghwahotola kunyoha.”
Yesu kakigholoha kibhoko kyake, kakinnyabhika pakalongela, “Nungupala ghuyoheke.” Kamu yula mundu kakilama maloha ghake.

Mbole Yesu kaking'ombela, “Ghuyihwe, ghukotoke kunng'ombela ywohele, ngati ghughende ghukalibhonehe kwa ndundame, na kutula matulo gha ghalaghilitwe na Musa ngati yibheghe ubhoneho kukita ghulamihwa.”
Yesu kangunlamiha ndumindumi ywa machonda kilongohi ghwa Akaaloma
Yesu pakayingiliti ku Kapelinaumu, machonda yumu kilongohi kakinhikila pakinnyupa utangwo,
kakilongela, “Bambo, ndumitumi ghwangu kaghonja ukaya, ntamwa ghwa ulelebhalo kangi kangubhina munu.”
Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Ndahika na kunlamiha.”
Peni yula kilongohi ywa machonda kakinng'ombela, “Bambo, nenga nungunoghwa ng'obhe kwa ghwenga kuyingila mu lubhagha lwangu. Peni ghukambuke lilagho ghweka, na nndumindumi ghwangu katalama.

Kiyaha na nenga ndo mundu numeghite na makakala, abhegha machonda pahi ya nenga. Panunng'ombela ayu ‘Ghughende,’ naywo kangughenda, na yungi panung'ombela ‘Ghuhike.’ Naywo kanguhika. Na panung'ombela nndumindumi ghwangu ‘Ghutende kilibhi aki.’ Naywo kangutenda.”

Yesu pakayihwite malagho ago kakikangacha, na kakiaghombela bhala bhandu bhaantughilite, “Kulyaghila nunguaghombela, nenga nangammona ng'obhe mundu ywohele hata mu Isilaeli, kabhegha na uhyubhalilo handa aghu.

Basi, nunguaghombela kukita bhandu atangalo bhaahika kuhuma kungeha na kulutipikila luchubha, nabho bhaatama mu chekwa ya kulyegha papamu na Abulahamu na Isaka na Yakobu mu Ghubhutwa ghwa kunani kwa Chapanga.
Peni bhala bhene Akaaisilaeli atangalo bhaahwacha ghubhutwa aghwo ndo ghwabhe, bhatataghwa panji mulubhindu, akwo bhaalila na kuhyagha mino.”
Mbole Yesu kakinng'ombela yula machonda kilongohi, “Ghughende ukaya kwako, na yibheghe handa paghuhyubhalila.” Na yula ndumindumi ywake kakilama lisaa lila lila.
Yesu kangualamiha bhandu atangalo
Yesu pakahikite ukaya kwa Petili, kakimmona mama ywa nhumbu ywa Petili kaghonja paulili kangubhina nhehemela.
Kakinnyabhikila kibhoko aywo mama na utamwa ghukinleka, kakiyinuka na kuyanda kukeya kuntelekela.
Payihikite makimuhi bhakinnyeghela bhandu atangalo bhaabheghite na mandilu. Naywo kakighabhuha ghala mandilu kwa lilagho lyake na kualamiha atamwa bhoha.
Agha ghakitendeka ngati litwihilike lila lilagho liikambukitwe na mbuye Isaya handa, “Ywombe katola mihehemela yetu na katola matamwa gha twenga.”
Bhanakunoghwa kuntughila Yesu
Yesu pakabhonite lumati lwa bhandu paluntindila, kakiakwilikiha ahundwa bhake bhayomboke kumwambo ya lihibha.
Nhunda yumu ywa malaghilo kakinng'endela, pakinng'ombela, “Nhunda, nenga ndakutughila kwohele kughupala kughenda.”
Yesu kakinnyanga, “Mabhweha abhegha na mbako, na hiyuni abhegha na hiyumba, peni Mwana ghwa Mundu kabhegha ng'obhe na pakupumulila.”
Mundu yungi mu ahundwa bhake kakinng'ombela, “Bambo, ghundegheke huti nikankulile tate ghwangu.”
Peni Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Ghundughile, ghubhaleke bhaaghweghite abhakulile bhala bhaaghweghite bhabhe.”
Yesu kangulinyamahila likusi
Yesu kakikwela mubhwato, na ahundwa bhake bhakintughila.
Paabheghite mu mwanja, pindulu likibwituka likusi likulu mu lihibha mbaka bhwato ghukiyanda kudibala kwa mayukano, peni Yesu kakibhegha kaghonja ng'ono.
Ahundwa bhake bhaking'endela, bhakinnyumuha paalongela, “Bambo, ghutulopohe, tunguhwegha.”
Naywo Yesu kakiaghombela, “Mwenga bhandu munakuhyubhalila kyamandina, kiyaha niki munguyoghopa?” Mbole kakiyinuka na kakililakalila lila likusi na lihibha, na kukibhegha tuli.
Bhala bhandu bhakikangacha, paalongela, “Ayu ndo mundu ywa kya bhuli mbaka likusi na lihibha hingunnyitikila!”
Yesu kangualamiha bhandu abhili bhaabheghite na mandilu

Yesu pakahikite kumwambo, ku nnima ghwa Akaagelasi, bhandu abhili bhaakwelitwe na mandilu bhakikongana na Yesu paahuma ku mandogholo. Bhandu abha bhakibhegha akalipa munu, mbaka kahone mundu ywakahotolite kupita mu njila yila.
Bhakituta kyobho paakilongela, “Ghubhegha na niki na twenga, Mwana ghwa Chapanga? Bhuli ghunguhika apa kutupamanda kukali ya linjubha liikwilikihitwe?”
Patali pamandina kuhuma pahala paabheghite, kukibhegha na lumati lwa maghulubhe paluhakilwa.
Ghala mandilu ghakinnyupa Yesu, “Handa paghutubhuha, ghutuleke tughende, tuyingile mu lula lumati lwa maghulubhe.”
Kakiaghombela, “Nng'ende.” Habhu bhakiabhuka bhandu bhala. Lumati lwoha lwa maghulubhe likihulukila kwa lubhilo uhelelo nkulu ghwa kitumbi, likiyingila mu luhibha na likihwegha mumachi.

Bhala bhaabheghiti mu kuahakila maghulubhe bhakibhutuka lubhilo na bhakeyingila mu kitami, bhakighenda kuaghomela bhandu mihalo hyoha ya milando yiibhabwitukilite bhala bhandu bhaakwelitwe na mandilu.
Mbole bhandu bhoha bha nnima ghula bhakibhuka na kughenda kukongana na Yesu. Na paammonite bhakinnyupa kabhuke mu nnima ghwabhe.
